evidence.V2: Clear big (curved blade) / medium (crescent guard, ball pommel, wrapped grip) / small (guard ball finials, wrap bands, fuller) hierarchy.

evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers on guard edges and blade bands catch light in the guard and fuller close-ups; edge bevel visible along the blade spine/edge.

evidence.V7: 2432 tris vs weapon target 2500 (ceiling 4000): at/under target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, gold/steel/teal palette and chamfer weight match the kit anchors.
